steps.title: Transfer mastermix to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Using a P20 GEN2 single‑channel pipette, dispense the mastermix from a 2 mL snap‑cap tube into the clean PCR plate.

steps.title: Add eluates to mastermix
steps.instruction: Using a P20 GEN2 multi‑channel pipette, transfer eluates from the RNA‑extraction plate into the PCR plate wells containing the mastermix, aligning each sample to the same well position (e.g., A1→A1, B1→B1, etc.).

steps.title: Dispense reaction mix
steps.instruction: With a P20 GEN2 single‑channel pipette and the same tip, add the reaction mix to each well of the clean PCR plate.

steps.title: Add eluates and mix
steps.instruction: Using a P20 GEN2 multi‑channel pipette, transfer eluates from the extraction plate to the PCR plate now containing the reaction mix; after each transfer, mix the sample 3 times by aspirating and dispensing 10 µL. Change tips for each sample.
